scope: Selected documentary context for historical constituency comparability; no geographic or forecast approval

records.title: ECI general-election schedule, published by PIB
records.locator: Paragraph 8 · Delimitation of Parliamentary and Assembly Constituencies
records.reviewMethod: Read the published paragraph and captured native text blocks; original HTML archived.
records.finding: The schedule identifies Manipur among the exceptions to the new delimitation exercise and the 2008 implementation described in the paragraph.
records.limit: This is dated 2009 operational context. It does not itself list the exact extent of each Assembly seat in the 2007 and 2012 elections.

records.title: ECI Lok Sabha seat backgrounder, published by PIB
records.locator: Table 1 · Manipur row and asterisk footnote
records.reviewMethod: Read the published row, table heading and exclusion footnote; original HTML archived.
records.finding: The Parliamentary seat-count table marks Manipur with a footnote for states excluded from the delimitation exercise.
records.limit: The table describes Parliamentary seat counts and reservations. It is not an Assembly boundary table; unchanged counts do not prove unchanged extents.

records.publisher: CEO Manipur copy of ECI candidate handbook
records.title: ECI Handbook for Candidate · CEO Manipur copy
records.reviewMethod: Visually inspected original PDF page 24; edition wording checked against the published title-page text. Other 471 pages are not claimed as visually reviewed.
records.finding: The handbook names Manipur among the exceptions to re-determination under the Delimitation Act, 2002. It directs candidates to consult an up-to-date corrected constituency order.
records.limit: This is later candidate guidance, not the original delimitation order, a 2012 election notification or a certified map. Do not treat the edition date as a legal effective date.

remainingEvidence.requirement: An attributable official source establishing the constituency framework actually used for the 2012 Manipur Assembly election, with any relevant amendments or corrections.
A documented AC-by-AC identity/extent comparison or an adequately supported legal-continuity finding. Names, counts and reference-map resemblance alone are insufficient.

Explicit input acceptance, exclusions and rules before computing any 2007→2012 score. A winner-party-only input may use an accepted original register without pretending that six full vote tables are repaired.

limitations: Three recovered sources supply documentary context, not three independent validations of geographic equality.
